subject: DeWALT 20V MAX 5.0Ah 4-pack $241.98 (retailer compare-at $498)
summary: A DeWALT DCB205 5.0Ah battery 4-pack at $241.98 at ToolNut, against the retailer's own $498 compare-at price.
body: Happy Thanksgiving. Today's pick: the DeWALT 20V MAX 5.0Ah battery 4-pack (DCB205) is $241.98 at ToolNut, in stock when we checked this morning. That works out to about $60.50 a pack.
ToolNut lists a compare-at price of $498, about 51% off. Compare-at is the retailer's own number, not a street price, so treat the discount as a ceiling. It also dropped $8 from $249.98 yesterday.
Tip: if your bench runs DeWALT 20V tools, four 5.0Ah packs covers a full day of grinding or impacting. Every deal we track is at offthetruckhq.com.
